about: Routes a tool may call although the public spec (api.talonic.com/v1/docs/openapi.json) lacks them. Each entry says why and where the platform serves it. scripts/check-routes.mjs fails when an entry is no longer used or the spec has it now, so this list only shrinks. Never add a route the platform does not serve.
